title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.14727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations,

translated_title: MHWA：多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 自回归世界模型已成为一种强大的样本高效决策范式，但其开环式推演往往表现出日益加剧的漂移，即使在相对较小的规划范围内也会导致误差累积。分层时间抽象通过缩短有效预测范围，是缓解此类漂移的天然候选方案；然而，现有的分层设计会引入额外的结构和概念上的复杂性，有时使其难以控制，并限制了其相对于扁平基线方法的增益。为此，我们提出了MHWA（多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型），它采用一种带跨步的高层上下文通道来降低全局上下文的更新频率，从而有效抑制复合漂移的传播。至关重要的是，通过上下文感知路由，门控网络利用全局上下文和当前观测，动态地重新配置低层专家混合结构……
tldr: 提出MHWA模型，通过带跨步的高层上下文通道降低全局上下文更新频率，并利用上下文感知路由动态重组低层专家混合结构，从而有效抑制自回归世界模型中开环推演的复合误差漂移。
en_tdlr: MHWA curbs compounding drift in autoregressive world models by employing a strided high-level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, combined with context-aware routing that dynamically reconfigures a low-level mixture of experts.
